title: Mass LinkedIn profile details
description: Add URLs directly, paste CSV, or upload a CSV file.

urlsCsv.title: Or paste CSV
urlsCsv.description: Header: url. Current Company Checker also accepts previousCompany.

fileUrl.title: Or upload a CSV file
fileUrl.description: CSV with a url or linkedinUrl column.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: How many profile URLs to process at the same time. Increase gradually for large runs.

resumeId.title: Resume ID (optional)
resumeId.description: Reuse this ID to skip URLs already completed in an earlier run. Lists over 20 continue even without an ID.

freshStart.title: Look up finished URLs again
freshStart.description: Turn this on to ignore saved progress and look up the whole list again.
